chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: After the Alabam: the Idaho band, school and Music Town
summary: After leaving the Alabam, Spikes took a band to Idaho for several summers, last in 1936, then studied for a few years before opening Music Town.

bands.name: Reb Spikes and His Majors and Minors Orchestra

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, I heard that, too. So after you and Heflin left the Alabam, what did you do?

By that...after we left there, let's see... I think that's when they come down and asked me to bring a band up to Idaho, you know, and I showed you that big ad, uh, building there, and I had to get a band together, and we went up there two, three summers after that. Then when I quit, I told you, around...the last trip was about '36, and then I went to school two, three years and finished that. Then I went into, uh, opened up Music Town after I went back East with this thing and come back. 'Course that was '40, wasn't it? And opened Music Town in '42.
